detail_text: This is a Pre-Solicitation Notice of the Government’s intent to issue a solicitation for the following requirement: National Stock Number: 8145-01-721-7161 Quantity: 76 Part Number: C21100005 Manufacturer: Gemstar Manufacturing, Inc.
